_comment: SCCL v4 — IN-UPDATE BASE ANCHORING (gold-free capability preservation). Diagnosis from the seeded v3 ladder (runs/sccl_v3, seed-42): every learning row — gold-free AND gold-verified vsr_nogold — collapses the arithmetic HOLDOUT to ~0.40 while frozen holds 0.60. The RRV gate protects CERTIFIED vault skills but cannot protect the base model's UNCERTIFIED general capability, because that damage happens INSIDE an accepted update (no accept/reject decision can stop it). v4 attacks the forgetting MECHANISM, not the gate: each SCCL update is pulled toward the frozen base (= LoRA init; disable_adapter equivalent) by a quadratic anchor penalty. Fully gold-free — the anchor target is the model's own initialization, no labels. Ladder (seeded torch_seed=42; compare WITHIN this run): frozen (control) < sccl (v1 point-cert ref) < sccl_anchor_lo / sccl_anchor_hi (v1 + base anchor, a small lambda ablation) < vsr_nogold (gold-test ref). sccl_anchor = v1 + ONLY the anchor (no replay/probe/nbhd) to isolate the mechanism. NOTE: vsr_nogold sits at learner index 4 with torch_seed 42, identical to the v3 run, so its row should reproduce v3's (determinism cross-check). Same stream/hash as sccl_main/v2/v3 (554ce43f182b).
